context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new P0 features fully functional: 1) Bulk operations (select, delete, categorize) work via /api/articles/bulk-delete and /api/articles/bulk-category. 2) Auto meta generation via /api/articles/auto-meta returns 3 title + 3 description variants with recommended set. 3) Version history auto-creates on article save, view/restore via /api/articles/{id}/versions endpoints. 4) Smart schedule via /api/articles/smart-schedule returns best_slot with day/time and distribution_plan.
